Triggers.Name: trg_deliverable_completion_lock_delete
Triggers.Statement:
BEGIN
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM `milestones` m
    WHERE m.completion_lock_request_id IS NOT NULL
      AND m.id IN (
        COALESCE(OLD.milestone_owner_id, 0),
        COALESCE((SELECT wi.milestone_id FROM work_items wi WHERE wi.id = OLD.target_id), 0),
        COALESCE((SELECT wi.milestone_id FROM work_items wi WHERE wi.id = OLD.matter_id), 0)
      )
  ) THEN
    SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000'
      SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'milestone_completion_request_locked';
  END IF;
END

Triggers.Name: trg_milestone_completion_lock_delete
trg_milestone_completion_lock_update
Triggers.Statement:
BEGIN
  IF OLD.completion_lock_request_id IS NOT NULL
     AND NOT (
       NEW.completion_lock_request_id IS NULL
       AND (
         NEW.status <=> OLD.status
         OR (OLD.status = 'active' AND NEW.status = 'completed')
       )
       AND NEW.project_id <=> OLD.project_id
       AND NEW.name <=> OLD.name
       AND NEW.description <=> OLD.description
       AND NEW.mode <=> OLD.mode
       AND NEW.start_date <=> OLD.start_date
       AND NEW.end_date <=> OLD.end_date
       AND NEW.pivr_stage <=> OLD.pivr_stage
       AND NEW.template_key <=> OLD.template_key
       AND NEW.payment_term_id <=> OLD.payment_term_id
       AND NEW.recurrence_rule <=> OLD.recurrence_rule
       AND NEW.sort_order <=> OLD.sort_order
     )
  THEN
    SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000'
      SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'milestone_completion_request_locked';
  END IF;
END

CREATE TABLE `product_priority_assessments` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,

  `scope_revision` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `evidence_revision` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `model_version` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,
  `model_snapshot` json NOT NULL,
  `strategic` tinyint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `user_value` tinyint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `business` tinyint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `risk` tinyint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `confidence` decimal(3,2) DEFAULT NULL,
  `effort_person_days` decimal(12,2) DEFAULT NULL,
  `effort_unit` varchar(16) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL DEFAULT 'person_day',
  `value_score` smallint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `priority_score` decimal(20,8) DEFAULT NULL,
  `evidence_snapshot` json NOT NULL,
  `rationale` json NOT NULL,
  `assessed_by` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,
  `estimated_by` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `assessed_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `model_method` varchar(32) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL DEFAULT 'weighted-value-effort',
  `rice_impact` decimal(3,2) DEFAULT NULL,
  `reach_observation_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_pc_assessment_identity` (`id`,`cycle_id`,`planning_item_id`),
  KEY `idx_pc_assessment_history` (`cycle_id`,`planning_item_id`,`id`),

  CONSTRAINT `fk_pc_assessment_reach` FOREIGN KEY (`reach_observation_id`, `planning_item_id`) REFERENCES `product_rice_reach_observations` (`id`, `planning_item_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_pc_assessment_confidence` CHECK ((`confidence` in (0.50,0.80,1.00))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_pc_assessment_dimensions` CHECK (((`strategic` <= 5) and (`user_value` <= 5) and (`business` <= 5) and (`risk` <= 5))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_pc_assessment_effort` CHECK ((`effort_person_days` between 0.50 and 1000000.00)),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_pc_assessment_method` CHECK ((`model_method` in (_utf8mb4'weighted-value-effort',_utf8mb4'rice'))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_pc_assessment_method_fields` CHECK ((((`model_method` = _utf8mb4'weighted-value-effort') and (`rice_impact` is null) and (`reach_observation_id` is null)) or ((`model_method` = _utf8mb4'rice') and (`strategic` is null) and (`user_value` is null) and (`business` is null) and (`risk` is null) and (`value_score` is null)))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_pc_assessment_model_complete` CHECK (((`priority_score` is null) or ((`confidence` is not null) and (`effort_person_days` is not null) and (((`model_method` = _utf8mb4'weighted-value-effort') and (`strategic` is not null) and (`user_value` is not null) and (`business` is not null) and (`risk` is not null) and (`value_score` is not null)) or ((`model_method` = _utf8mb4'rice') and (`rice_impact` is not null) and (`reach_observation_id` is not null)))))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_pc_assessment_rice_impact` CHECK ((`rice_impact` in (0.25,0.50,1.00,2.00,3.00))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_pc_assessment_score` CHECK ((`priority_score` >= 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_pc_assessment_unit` CHECK ((`effort_unit` = _utf8mb4'person_day')),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_pc_assessment_value` CHECK ((`value_score` <= 100))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin

  `cycle_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `item_revision` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `scope_revision` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `evidence_revision` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `cycle_revision` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `queue_revision` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `starts_on` date NOT NULL,
  `ends_on` date NOT NULL,
  `item_snapshot` json NOT NULL,
  `decision_snapshot` json NOT NULL,
  `model_snapshot` json NOT NULL,
  `reason` text CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,
  `created_by` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL,

  CONSTRAINT `ck_pc_roadmap_commitment_dates` CHECK ((`ends_on` >= `starts_on`)),

Tables.Name: asset_offboarding_recovery_cases
Tables.DDL:
CREATE TABLE `asset_offboarding_recovery_cases` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `case_code` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Assets 离职资产回收事项稳定编码',
  `source_app` varchar(50) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '离职生命周期投影来源应用',
  `source_event_key` varchar(191) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '来源稳定幂等事件键',
  `source_payload_sha256` char(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '已验证 People 离职投影载荷摘要；同事件异载荷冲突',
  `departed_employee_uid` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '已离职员工UID；禁止作为收件人',
  `departed_employee_name` varchar(191) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '离职时姓名快照，不作为身份事实',
  `offboarded_at` datetime NOT NULL COMMENT '离职生效时间',
  `recovery_due_at` date NOT NULL COMMENT '资产回收期限（UTC 日期语义）',
  `recovery_responsible_uid` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Assets 内显式维护的唯一回收责任人；NULL 表示待分配',
  `status` enum('active','resolved','cancelled') CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
  `created_by` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_by` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_aorc_case_code` (`case_code`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_aorc_source_event` (`source_app`,`source_event_key`),
  KEY `idx_aorc_due` (`status`,`recovery_due_at`,`id`),
  KEY `idx_aorc_departed` (`departed_employee_uid`,`status`),
  KEY `idx_aorc_responsible` (`recovery_responsible_uid`,`status`,`recovery_due_at`),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_aorc_identity` CHECK (((`case_code` = trim(`case_code`)) and (`case_code` <> _utf8mb4'') and (`source_app` = _utf8mb4'people') and (`source_event_key` = trim(`source_event_key`)) and (`source_event_key` <> _utf8mb4'') and regexp_like(`source_payload_sha256`,_utf8mb4'^[0-9a-f]{64}$') and (`departed_employee_uid` = trim(`departed_employee_uid`)) and (`departed_employee_uid` <> _utf8mb4'') and (lower(`departed_employee_uid`) <> _utf8mb4'@all'))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_aorc_responsible` CHECK (((`recovery_responsible_uid` is null) or ((`recovery_responsible_uid` = trim(`recovery_responsible_uid`)) and (`recovery_responsible_uid` <> _utf8mb4'') and (lower(`recovery_responsible_uid`) <> _utf8mb4'@all') and (`recovery_responsible_uid` <> `departed_employee_uid`) and (not(regexp_like(`recovery_responsible_uid`,_utf8mb4'[[:cntrl:]]'))))))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Assets 离职员工未归还资产回收事项'

CREATE TABLE `customer_delivery_asset_environment_rel` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `delivery_asset_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT '客户交付资产ID',
  `environment_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT '正式环境ID',
  `relation_type` enum('primary','test','production','backup','disaster_recovery','training','other') CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'primary',
  `is_primary` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '是否当前主环境',
  `deployment_status` enum('planned','provisioning','deployed','online','accepted','suspended','removed') CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'planned',
  `deployed_version` varchar(100) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '该交付资产在此环境中的当前部署版本',
  `effective_from` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '生效时间',
  `effective_to` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '结束时间',
  `status` enum('active','ended','cancelled') CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
  `source_project_code` varchar(191) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '来源 Aims 项目编码',
  `created_by` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_by` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `deleted_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `active_relation_key` varchar(255) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci GENERATED ALWAYS AS ((case when (`deleted_at` is null) then concat(`delivery_asset_id`,_utf8mb4':',`environment_id`,_utf8mb4':',`relation_type`) else NULL end)) STORED,
  `active_primary_key` varchar(191) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci GENERATED ALWAYS AS ((case when ((`deleted_at` is null) and (`status` = _utf8mb4'active') and (`is_primary` = 1)) then cast(`delivery_asset_id` as char charset utf8mb4) else NULL end)) STORED,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_cdaer_active_relation` (`active_relation_key`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_cdaer_active_primary` (`active_primary_key`),
  KEY `idx_cdaer_delivery_asset` (`delivery_asset_id`,`status`),
  KEY `idx_cdaer_environment` (`environment_id`,`status`),
  KEY `idx_cdaer_source_project` (`source_project_code`,`status`),
  KEY `idx_cdaer_status` (`deployment_status`,`status`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_cdaer_delivery_asset` FOREIGN KEY (`delivery_asset_id`) REFERENCES `customer_delivery_assets` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_cdaer_environment` FOREIGN KEY (`environment_id`) REFERENCES `asset_environments` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='客户交付资产与正式环境部署关系'

  `product_version` varchar(100) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '产品版本',
  `catalog_item_code` varchar(100) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '目录项编码',
  `product_origin` varchar(30) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '产品来源',
  `asset_kind` varchar(50) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'software' COMMENT '交付资产类型',
  `deployment_mode` varchar(50) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '部署模式',
  `instance_key` varchar(100) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '实例键',
  `tenant_key` varchar(100) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '租户键',
  `environment_code` varchar(100) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '环境编码',
  `license_model` varchar(50) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '授权模型',
  `license_quantity` decimal(18,4) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '授权数量',
  `capacity` decimal(18,4) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '容量',
  `unit` varchar(30) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '单位',
  `status` enum('planned','provisioning','delivered','online','accepted','suspended','expired','terminated') CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'planned' COMMENT '生命周期状态',
  `planned_delivery_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '计划交付时间',
  `delivered_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '交付时间',
  `go_live_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '上线时间',
  `accepted_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '验收时间',
  `expired_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '到期时间',
  `terminated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '终止时间',
  `warranty_start_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '质保开始时间',
  `warranty_end_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '质保结束时间',
  `support_expiry_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '支持到期时间',
  `responsible_uid` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Assets 内维护的交付资产运营责任人；不得由跨模块合同负责人隐式推导',
  `responsible_dept_code` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '运营责任部门；仅用于用户目标页数据范围，不作为通知广播对象',
  `source_app` varchar(50) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'altoc' COMMENT '来源应用',
  `source_biz_code` varchar(100) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '来源业务编码',
  `source_plan_code` varchar(100) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '来源计划编码',
  `idempotency_key` varchar(240) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '幂等键',
  `altoc_status_sync_revision` bigint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '仅目标相关事实变化时递增的Altoc同步revision',
  `altoc_status_sync_fingerprint` char(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '目标相关事实规范化SHA-256',
  `altoc_status_sync_occurred_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '当前revision冻结发生时间',
  `created_by` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_by` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `deleted_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_customer_delivery_asset_code` (`delivery_asset_code`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_customer_delivery_asset_line` (`contract_code`,`contract_line_code`,`instance_key`),
  KEY `idx_customer_delivery_asset_customer` (`customer_code`,`status`),
  KEY `idx_customer_delivery_asset_contract` (`contract_code`,`status`),
  KEY `idx_customer_delivery_asset_project` (`project_code`,`status`),
  KEY `idx_customer_delivery_asset_source_plan` (`source_plan_code`),
  KEY `idx_customer_delivery_asset_product` (`product_code`),
  KEY `idx_customer_delivery_asset_asset_item` (`asset_item_code`),
  KEY `idx_customer_delivery_asset_responsibility` (`responsible_uid`,`responsible_dept_code`,`status`),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_customer_delivery_asset_responsibility_pair` CHECK ((((`responsible_uid` is null) and (`responsible_dept_code` is null)) or ((`responsible_uid` is not null) and (trim(`responsible_uid`) <> _utf8mb4'') and (lower(trim(`responsible_uid`)) <> _utf8mb4'@all') and (`responsible_uid` = trim(`responsible_uid`)) and (`responsible_dept_code` is not null) and (trim(`responsible_dept_code`) <> _utf8mb4'') and (`responsible_dept_code` = trim(`responsible_dept_code`)))))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='客户交付资产主档'

Tables.Name: integration_operation
Tables.DDL:
CREATE TABLE `integration_operation` (
  `operation_id` char(36) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `operation_key` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `correlation_key` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `sequence_no` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `depends_on_operation_key` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `tenant_code` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `deployment_code` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `source_app` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `target_app` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `operation_code` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `required_capability` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `source_biz_type` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `source_biz_code` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `target_receipt_id` char(36) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `target_biz_type` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `target_biz_code` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `idempotency_key` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `command_schema_version` varchar(30) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'v1',
  `command_json` json NOT NULL,
  `command_sha256` char(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  `attempt_count` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `max_attempts` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '8',
  `next_attempt_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
  `last_attempt_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `locked_by` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `locked_until` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `fencing_token` bigint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `version_no` bigint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `original_request_id` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `correlation_id` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `original_actor_uid` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `service_client_id` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `replay_count` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `last_replay_actor_uid` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_replay_reason` varchar(500) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_replay_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_http_status` smallint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_error_code` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_error_class` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_error_summary` varchar(1000) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_error_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `response_summary_sha256` char(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `failure_notified_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `failure_notification_id` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `succeeded_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `failed_permanent_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `dead_lettered_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `cancelled_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_by` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_by` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
  `updated_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
  PRIMARY KEY (`operation_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_assets_iop_identity` (`tenant_code`,`deployment_code`,`source_app`,`target_app`,`operation_code`,`idempotency_key`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_assets_iop_key` (`tenant_code`,`deployment_code`,`source_app`,`operation_key`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_assets_iop_sequence` (`tenant_code`,`deployment_code`,`source_app`,`correlation_key`,`sequence_no`),
  KEY `idx_assets_iop_due` (`status`,`next_attempt_at`,`locked_until`),
  KEY `idx_assets_iop_lock` (`status`,`locked_until`),
  KEY `idx_assets_iop_dependency` (`tenant_code`,`deployment_code`,`source_app`,`depends_on_operation_key`),
  KEY `idx_assets_iop_failure` (`tenant_code`,`deployment_code`,`source_app`,`status`,`failure_notified_at`,`dead_lettered_at`,`operation_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_assets_iop_cross_app` CHECK ((`source_app` <> `target_app`)),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_assets_iop_status` CHECK ((`status` in (_utf8mb4'pending',_utf8mb4'processing',_utf8mb4'retry_wait',_utf8mb4'partial_unknown',_utf8mb4'succeeded',_utf8mb4'failed_permanent',_utf8mb4'dead_letter',_utf8mb4'cancelled')))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

Tables.Name: integration_operation_dead_letter_actionable
Tables.DDL:
CREATE TABLE `integration_operation_dead_letter_actionable` (
  `operation_id` char(36) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '来源integration operation UUID',
  `generation_no` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT '以进入dead_letter时operation version作为单调generation',
  `tenant_code` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `deployment_code` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `source_app` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `target_app` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `operation_code` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `source_biz_type` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `source_biz_code` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `attempt_count` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `max_attempts` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `last_error_code` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '安全稳定错误码；不保存raw error',
  `last_error_class` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `dead_lettered_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `original_actor_uid` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `source_operation_version` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `actionable_key` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `publish_object_version` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `notification_id` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `recipient_uids` json DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Console实际返回的规范化显式收件UID数组',
  `publish_acked_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `closure_state` varchar(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'resolved/cancelled',
  `closure_object_version` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `closure_pending_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `closure_acked_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
  `updated_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
  PRIMARY KEY (`operation_id`,`generation_no`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_assets_iopdla_actionable` (`tenant_code`,`deployment_code`,`source_app`,`actionable_key`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_assets_iopdla_notification` (`tenant_code`,`deployment_code`,`source_app`,`notification_id`),
  KEY `idx_assets_iopdla_publish` (`tenant_code`,`deployment_code`,`source_app`,`publish_acked_at`,`dead_lettered_at`),
  KEY `idx_assets_iopdla_closure` (`tenant_code`,`deployment_code`,`source_app`,`closure_acked_at`,`closure_pending_at`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_assets_iopdla_operation` FOREIGN KEY (`operation_id`) REFERENCES `integration_operation` (`operation_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `chk_assets_iopdla_closure` CHECK (((`closure_state` is null) or (`closure_state` in (_utf8mb4'resolved',_utf8mb4'cancelled')))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_assets_iopdla_recipient` CHECK (((`recipient_uids` is null) or (json_type(`recipient_uids`) = _utf8mb4'ARRAY')))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Assets跨应用死信actionable generation发布与closure证据'

Tables.Name: service_command_receipt
Tables.DDL:
CREATE TABLE `service_command_receipt` (
  `receipt_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `operation_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `operation_code` varchar(191) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `tenant_code` varchar(100) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `source_deployment_code` varchar(100) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `deployment_code` varchar(100) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `source_app` varchar(50) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `target_app` varchar(50) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `required_capability` varchar(191) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `idempotency_key` varchar(191) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `identity_sha256` binary(32) GENERATED ALWAYS AS (unhex(sha2(concat_ws(_utf8mb4'|',`tenant_code`,`source_deployment_code`,`deployment_code`,`source_app`,`target_app`,`operation_code`,`idempotency_key`),256))) STORED,
  `command_schema_version` varchar(30) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'v1',
  `command_sha256` char(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(32) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'processing',
  `locked_by` varchar(100) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `locked_until` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `fencing_token` bigint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `version_no` bigint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `first_request_id` varchar(100) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_request_id` varchar(100) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `correlation_id` varchar(100) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `original_actor_uid` varchar(100) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `service_client_id` varchar(100) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `target_biz_type` varchar(100) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `target_biz_code` varchar(191) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `response_http_status` smallint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `response_summary_sha256` char(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_error_code` varchar(100) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_error_class` varchar(50) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_error_summary` varchar(1000) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `received_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
  `last_received_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
  `completed_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
  `updated_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
  PRIMARY KEY (`receipt_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_scr_operation_id` (`operation_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_scr_identity` (`identity_sha256`),
  KEY `idx_scr_status_lock` (`status`,`locked_until`),
  KEY `idx_scr_target_biz` (`tenant_code`,`deployment_code`,`target_app`,`target_biz_type`,`target_biz_code`),
  KEY `idx_scr_received` (`received_at`),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_scr_cross_app` CHECK (((`source_app` <> `target_app`) or ((`source_app` = _utf8mb4'assets') and (`target_app` = _utf8mb4'assets') and (`source_deployment_code` = `deployment_code`) and (`original_actor_uid` is not null) and (char_length(trim(`original_actor_uid`)) > 0) and (`command_schema_version` = _utf8mb4'assets-owned-command.v1') and (((`operation_code` in (_utf8mb4'assets.products.create.v1',_utf8mb4'assets.products.edit.v1',_utf8mb4'assets.products.link-base.v1',_utf8mb4'assets.products.link-asset.v1',_utf8mb4'assets.products.link-document.v1')) and (`required_capability` = _utf8mb4'assets:product:edit')) or ((`operation_code` = _utf8mb4'assets.product-categories.save.v1') and (`required_capability` = _utf8mb4'assets:admin:admin')))))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_scr_status` CHECK ((`status` in (_utf8mb4'processing',_utf8mb4'succeeded',_utf8mb4'rejected')))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='目标服务命令 Inbox 回执；业务 mutation 与 succeeded 必须同事务'
